zoom_line: You get three images of the same photo: image 1 is the whole photo; image 2 is a close-up of the main person's upper body; image 3 is a close-up of their lower body down to the feet. Describe each garment once, from image 1, and use the close-ups for details: footwear type, hems, leg shape, sleeves, fabric and logos.
boot_line: - Boots: a boot whose shaft is hidden by the pant hem is still a boot; judge footwear by the toe box, sole and laces. "work_boot" = rugged lace-up boot with a thick lug sole; "suede_chukka" = ankle-high suede boot with 2-3 eyelets and a thin sole; "chelsea_boot" = elastic side panels, no laces.
